title: ischaemum hispidum
intro: Ischaemum hispidum, commonly known as East Indian grass, is a type of plant belonging to the Poaceae family. This plant has been found to have various health benefits, including reducing inflammation and improving respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of East Indian grass include its potential to treat fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions, as well as its use in traditional medicine for its antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ischaemum hispidum include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other secondary metabolites that contribute to its medicinal properties.
